# Leaderboarded

> > Leaderboarded is a no-code platform for creating live leaderboards, scoreboards, and competition tracking tools for teams, classrooms, events, and communities.

Founded by Caspar von Wrede, Leaderboarded enables users to build customizable leaderboards from Excel and Google Sheets, with features for sales competitions, classroom management (PBIS-aligned), sports events, fundraising goals, and live streaming overlays (OBS/vMix compatible). The platform offers both free tools like click counters and premium competition tracking solutions.

## Key Topics

- Leaderboard creation
- Competition tracking
- Google Sheets integration
- Excel data visualization
- Sales team performance
- Classroom behavior management (PBIS)
- Live streaming overlays (OBS)
- Team building activities
- Fantasy sports standings
- Race results publishing
- Fundraising goal tracking
- Bar chart race visualization
- No-code tools
- Real-time scoreboards
- Remote team productivity

## Core Tools & Features

- [Free Online Click Counter | Tally Counter Tool](https://leaderboarded.com/click-counter): Free click/tally counter tool with multi-counter and keyboard shortcuts
- [How to Create Your Own Live Bar Chart Race](https://leaderboarded.com/blog/posts/create-bar-chart-race): No-code tool for creating live animated bar chart race visualizations
- [Racing times leaderboard: How to put your results online with a search field](https://leaderboarded.com/blog/posts/publishing-race-results-online): Publish searchable race results online from Excel spreadsheets
